page.layout: One page of text; a decorative head-piece above the title; a large woodcut initial opening the first paragraph; signature mark at the foot; page number at top right.

main_text.l: IPray make a little roome for a

l.i: Cobler, his work was done in time,
but a ship setting Jayle one day
too soon makes it appeare soms
weeks too late; Seeing hee is so
reasonable as to demand no other pay for
his labour and leather, but leave to pay us well
for our faults, let it be well accepted, as Counsell in our
occasions to come, and as Testimony to what is past,

page.notes: The first word is a large woodcut initial "I" joined to "Pray"; the printed text reads "Pray make a little roome for a Cobler ..." with the initial standing for the opening letter. Long s rendered as s throughout. "Gentlemen," and "By a Friend." are set in roman/italic as printed; the signature line "By a Friend." is right-aligned. A faint ink mark near the middle of the page is not text.
